simple.meaning: חֲרַךְ (chărak) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to scorch.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H2761. charak [ חֲרַךְ ] verb singe ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Late Hebrew חָרַח ); — Hithpa`el Perfect 3masculine singular הִתְחָרַח Dan 3:27 (of hair).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of 2787 ;

occurrences.englishText: The local governors, the deputies, and the governors, and the king’s counselors, being gathered together, saw these men, that the fire had no power on their bodies. The hair of their head wasn’t singed. Their pants weren’t changed, the smell of fire wasn’t even on them.
